entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A powerful necromancer who terrorized Terisiare in the Ice Age, waged two campaigns to conquer Shandalar, and whose fragment haunts Liliana Vess as the Raven Man.

entities.name: Raven Man
entities.description: The fragment of Lim-Dûl's essence from the Ring of Mairsil, appearing as an older man with white hair and gold eyes who haunts and manipulates Liliana Vess.

entities.name: Ring of Mairsil
entities.description: The ring that granted Lim-Dûl his powers and holds Mairsil's imprint and a shred of Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: A wizard locked inside his ring for nearly 2500 years who partially controls Lim-Dûl to punish Jodah.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A planeswalker who gifts and mutates Lim-Dûl and intends to use his undead army to conquer Shandalar.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: The Archmage Eternal whom Lim-Dûl enslaves and later fights.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Jodah's old friend who helps him escape and later ascends as a planeswalker.

entities.name: Gerda Äagesdotter
entities.description: A mage who sold out Jodah to Lim-Dûl to take his place as Archmage.

entities.name: Márton Stromgald
entities.description: A Kjeldoran leader reanimated by Lim-Dûl as a zombie to create the Knights of Stromgald.

entities.name: King Darien
entities.description: King of Kjeldor, saved by Jodah, who unites Kjeldor and forges an alliance with the Balduvians.

entities.name: Knights of Stromgald
entities.description: Knights created by Lim-Dûl who plotted a coup and were poisoned and zombified.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: The nation of Lim-Dûl's origin, allied in the end with the Balduvians.

entities.name: Balduvians
entities.description: Barbarians who ally with Kjeldor against Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Tresserhorn
entities.description: The keep Lim-Dûl built where he found the ring.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl's Battle
entities.description: The last battle of the Ice Age, in which Leshrac dismembers Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: A mana-rich plane that Lim-Dûl campaigns twice to conquer.

entities.name: Kenan Sahrmal
entities.description: Shandalar's guardian who defends against Leshrac and trains apprentices.

entities.name: Azar
entities.description: Sahrmal's oldest apprentice who traps Lim-Dûl's spirit within his own body to create the Great Barrier.

entities.name: Ardestan
entities.description: The last refuge city on Shandalar during Lim-Dûl's War.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: A magical artifact that imprisons Lim-Dûl's soul and keeps the Great Barrier intact.

entities.name: Great Barrier
entities.description: The barrier around Shandalar that depends on Lim-Dûl's confinement.

entities.name: Arzakon
entities.description: A planeswalker who started Arzakon's War to seek Shandalar's wild mana.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker haunted by the Raven Man, who deduces his identity and defeats Phyrexians at the Vess estate.

entities.name: Josu Vess
entities.description: Liliana's brother, poisoned and turned into a lich by the Raven Man's cure.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who noticed the Raven Man while mentally assaulting Liliana on Innistrad.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker who helps Liliana relieve herself of the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Elas il-Kor
entities.description: A Phyrexian who leads a group searching for Lim-Dûl's ring.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A planeswalker who arrived on Shandalar with Leshrac and Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders searching for Lim-Dûl's ring on the eve of the new invasion of Dominaria.

events.summary: Lim-Dûl flees from a battle with goblins and, caught in a blizzard, finds the ring of Mairsil among the remains of the Conclave of Mages.
events.quote: Lim-Dûl fled while the others were slaughtered.

events.summary: The ring grants Lim-Dûl great power; he builds Tresserhorn and becomes a necromancer, with Leshrac and Mairsil manipulating him.
events.quote: The ring granted him incredible powers that not only allowed him to survive the blizzard but also to become a powerful necromancer.

events.summary: Gerda sells out Jodah, and Lim-Dûl muddles his memory and makes him research planes and ways to kill a planeswalker.
events.quote: Lim-Dûl had Jodah also research ways to kill a planeswalker

events.summary: Leshrac discovers the plan and mutates Lim-Dûl, giving him horns.
events.quote: Leshrac discovered this and mutated his minion, giving him horns

events.summary: Jodah escapes with Jaya Ballard and they seek to unite Kjeldor with the Balduvians.
events.quote: Jodah escaped with the aid of his old friend Jaya Ballard

events.summary: Lim-Dûl poisons the Knights of Stromgald when they plot a coup, zombifying them; Jodah saves King Darien and Kjeldor allies with the Balduvians.
events.quote: allowed Darien to unite them and forge an alliance with the Balduvians

events.summary: In the last battle, Lim-Dûl faces Jodah under Mairsil's control, and Leshrac cuts off Lim-Dûl's hand and tears him apart.
events.quote: Lim-Dûl was turned into a living ball of raw flesh that Leshrac took with him off-plane

events.summary: Kenan Sahrmal defends Shandalar, but Lim-Dûl is beheaded by Sahrmal's followers and survives by moving his soul to another body.
events.quote: Lim-Dûl had survived by transferring his soul into another body

events.summary: Twelve years later Lim-Dûl returns with an undead army and destroys city after city on Shandalar until only Ardestan remains.
Azar casts a spell to imprison Lim-Dûl's spirit and create the Great Barrier, but both spirits become trapped in Azar's body.
events.quote: The combined spells had the unforeseen effect of trapping both spirits within Azar’s body.

events.summary: Azar falls and Lim-Dûl resumes his campaign, but is finally defeated in the Wizard's War and his soul imprisoned in the Chain Veil.
events.quote: imprisoned it within the Chain Veil , a magical artifact that kept the Great Barrier intact

events.summary: Arzakon tricks the guild masters into casting the Spell of Dominion, meant to destroy the Chain Veil, but is thwarted.
events.quote: Arzakon's plans were thwarted, and both he and the guild lords were defeated by one of the plane's spellcasters

events.summary: Mairsil's ring coerces Jaya into picking it up; the possessed Jaya stabs Jodah at Soldev and destroys Soldev and the School of the Unseen, until Jaya ascends and expels the minds.
events.quote: Jaya ascended and removed the minds of Lim-Dûl and Mairsil from herself.

events.summary: The Raven Man appears to Liliana and offers a cure for her poisoned brother Josu, who is turned into a lich, igniting her spark.
events.quote: it came at the cost of turning him into a lich, an event that would ignite Liliana's planeswalker's spark

events.summary: The Raven Man orchestrates Liliana's discovery of the Chain Veil on Shandalar.
events.quote: A while later, the Raven Man orchestrated Liliana's discovery of the Chain Veil on Shandalar .

events.summary: The Raven Man protects Liliana from Jace on Innistrad and is noticed by Jace.
events.quote: During this scuffle, Jace noticed the Raven Man's presence

events.summary: The Raven Man reappears to Liliana on Amonkhet and saves her life by taking control of the Chain Veil.
events.quote: even saved her life again by taking control over the Chain Veil

events.summary: With Ugin's help Liliana relieves herself of the Chain Veil, to the Raven Man's disappointment.
events.quote: He was utterly disappointed when Liliana, with the help of Ugin , managed to relieve herself of the Chain Veil .

events.summary: Liliana deduces the Raven Man's identity and defeats a Phyrexian group led by Elas il-Kor at the Vess estate, refusing the ring's offer of power.
events.quote: However, she refused and successfully defeated the Phyrexians herself.

relations.quote: Leshrac discovered this and mutated his minion
looking to punish the last living person who had played a role in his first downfall: the Archmage Eternal Jodah
Jodah escaped with the aid of his old friend Jaya Ballard
who sought to manipulate Liliana to do his bidding
The fragment of his essence contained within the Ring of Mairsil is known as The Raven Man .
